title: WT Terminal a11y Type/Read Design
desc: Design spec: CASCADIA_HOSTING_WINDOW_CLASS support for a11y type and read. type uses PostMessage WM_CHAR to InputSite (focusless, no 10s timeout). read uses TextPattern.DocumentRange.GetText. Both verified.
steps: ROOT CAUSE: wkappbot a11y type on CASCADIA_HOSTING_WINDOW_CLASS fails after 10s UIA timeout. ValuePattern.SetValue unavailable on WT terminal; SendInput misses InputSite child. a11y read returns only Name+Value concat, ignores existing TextPattern on terminal Text element.
TARGET FILES: Add TerminalWindowHelper.cs to WKAppBot.Win32. Hook ActionExecutor type action (pre-check IsTerminalWindow) and read action (check TextPattern before Name+Value fallback).

TERMINALWINDOWHELPER API: (1) IsTerminalWindow(hwnd)=GetClassName==CASCADIA_HOSTING_WINDOW_CLASS. (2) FindInputSite(hwnd)=EnumChildWindows for Windows.UI.Input.InputSite.WindowClass child. (3) TypeToTerminal(hwnd,text)=PostMessage(inputSite,WM_CHAR=0x0102,char,Zero) per char 10ms NO SetForegroundWindow. (4) ReadTerminalText(hwnd,tabName)=AutomationElement.FromHandle(hwnd).FindFirst(Descendants,NameProperty==tabName).TextPattern.DocumentRange.GetText(4000).

TYPE HOOK in ActionExecutor: before UIA SetValue path add: if(TerminalWindowHelper.IsTerminalWindow(resolvedHwnd)){TerminalWindowHelper.TypeToTerminal(resolvedHwnd,text);return Ok;} -- eliminates 10s timeout, fully focusless.

READ HOOK in ActionExecutor: after GetAutomationElement add: if(element.GetSupportedPatterns().Contains(TextPattern.Pattern)){return ((TextPattern)element.GetCurrentPattern(TextPattern.Pattern)).DocumentRange.GetText(4000);} -- TextPattern on WT terminal Text element already implemented, just not called.

POWERSHELL PROOF (verified in session): TypeToTerminal -- WkAutoQuant Claude received WM_CHAR message and responded without focus disruption. ReadTerminalText -- full terminal text returned via UIAutomationClient. Both confirmed focusless via screenshot.
SMOKE TESTS: wkappbot a11y type test CASCADIA_HWND => OK no 10s wait. wkappbot a11y read CASCADIA_HWND => terminal text returned not empty. focus stays on caller window throughout.

requirements.expect: terminal text content returned not empty
